name: mikoshi-construct
description: Bootstrap for AI-native software projects. Start with a proven engineering workflow instead of an empty repository.
author: Eli Tabrisov

scripts.contract:update: node --import tsx scripts/contract/update.ts && node --import tsx scripts/contract/surface.ts
scripts.docs:build: node --import tsx src/cli.ts atlas --out .construct/atlas.html && vitepress build docs
scripts.quality: node --import tsx scripts/quality/lock.ts node --import tsx scripts/scratch/run.ts pnpm run quality:steps
scripts.quality:steps: pnpm composition:check && pnpm model:check && pnpm privacy:check && pnpm layers:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:pending && pnpm docs:anchors
scripts.release: pnpm build && node --import tsx scripts/release/stage-publish.ts && changeset tag

scriptsOutsideTheHarness.approve: lists the owner's approval queue and writes or revokes an approval when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.board: a read-only print of the factory board from the cards, prs and tasks projections of bus.db, not a verdict on a change
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.build: produces the package, the bundled CLI and the factory built file by file, rather than judging it; tests/package-factory.test.ts packs and starts what it builds
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:agent: renders the owner's launchd agent and prints its diff when run by hand, and replaces and reloads it only with --apply; its own tests, on a launchctl stub, are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:answer: the answer worker over bus.db, switched off unless started by hand with --on; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:bg: starts bus:run, the switched-on workers and their supervisor as one detached instance each when run by hand; its own tests, on nohup and pnpm stubs and a scratch git repository, are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:close: the close worker over bus.db, switched off unless started by hand with --on; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:import: imports the journal into bus.db once when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:inbox: a read-only print of the owner inbox from bus.db when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:launch: the launch worker over bus.db, switched off unless started by hand with --on; it starts card sessions as detached processes, so its own tests, on a claude stub, are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:merge: the merge worker over bus.db, switched off unless started by hand with --on after the first live review verdict; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:netwatch: a long-running poller that writes GitHub observations into bus.db; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:reduce: rebuilds the prs, cards, tasks, decisions and card_bodies projections of bus.db when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:report: a read-only shadow report over bus.db and GitHub printed by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:request: writes one window.request into bus.db for bus:run to answer when the window runs it; it executes nothing itself; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:restart: the restart worker over bus.db, switched off unless started by hand with --on; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:review: the live review worker over bus.db, switched off unless started by hand with --on or run once with --dry-run; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:review:bg: starts bus:review --on as the one detached instance when run by hand, after a clean shadow report; its own tests, on nohup and pnpm stubs, are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:run: a long-running shadow process of NetWatch, the reducer and the review queue over bus.db; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:slot: runs one heavy command under a slot of bus.db when run by hand or by a caller; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:update: the update worker over bus.db, switched off unless started by hand with --on after the first live review verdict; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:witness: the witness worker over bus.db, switched off unless started by hand with --on; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.bus:witness-backfill: writes the one witness.fields.backfilled event into bus.db when run by hand and changes no card text; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.card: prints one card of the card_bodies projection of bus.db, as a contract's JSON fields, its admitted text or its chain, when run by hand; it writes nothing; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.card:measure: a read-only print of sessions, tokens by role, verdict reasons and mechanism noise per merged card from bus.db, for the window to give the owner, not a verdict on a change; scripts/tests/bus/card-measure.test.ts is its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.checks:catalog: rewrites the check_tests and check_mutations tables of bus.db from the test graph, the briefs and the journal when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.checks:matrix: runs the catalog mutations of the layers a list of changed paths reaches against their own tests when run by hand, and prints the matrix; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.ci:select: prints the layers and tests a list of changed paths reaches, the selection the CI vitest job takes on a pull request; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.composition:render: a writer; composition:check is its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.contract:bump: a gate, deliberately outside: it needs the release tags and full history, so it runs in its own CI job with fetch-depth 0
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.contract:overlaps: a read-only print of the sites behind the overlaps of contract/factory.json; tests/contract/factory.test.ts is its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.contract:update: a writer; tests/contract/surface.test.ts, tests/contract/factory.test.ts and tests/scripts-registry.test.ts are its gates
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.decisions: prints the owner decisions in force, refusing a file that breaks the numbered record; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.decisions:add: appends one owner decision and its decision.recorded event when run by hand, restoring the file on a refusal or a failed event write; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.done:check: a step a reviewer runs on a finished ladder run; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.factory:start: starts the factory and installs its keep-alive when run by hand, as construct-factory does from the package; tests/factory-start.test.ts, on nohup, ps and launchctl stubs, is its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.gate:window: prints the window gate of D-194 for the tree it runs in, the ci:select layers of its changes against origin/main; it judges nothing itself, and its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.ghosts:cleanup: removes a merged task's worktree and quality logs when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.ghosts:expect-sample: a read-only forecast printed by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.ghosts:hash: a hand-run tool for computing an approval hash; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.ghosts:launch: opens headless sessions after a human confirmation; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.ghosts:role: prints which route, local or cloud, a role takes; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.ghosts:verdict: appends one journal line after a review verdict file holds its schema and its digests; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.ghosts:watch: a read-only view of running sessions, not a verdict on a change
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.handoff:check: a hand-run check of a handoff file; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.handoff:write: the only writer of a handoff file, run by hand or by a session; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.intake: construct intake with its card events written to the bus when run by hand, as construct-intake does from the package; its own tests and tests/intake-from-package.test.ts are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.lint:fix: a fixer; lint is its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.miko: runs Mikoshi sessions in a loop in the owner's terminal when run by hand; its own tests, on a claude stub, are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.miko:exit: ends the claude of the current Mikoshi window when a session runs it; its own tests, on a claude stub under the loop, are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.miko:pull: pulls main into the window's tree when the window runs it, or hands the owner the pull command; its own tests, on scratch git repositories, are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.miko:watch: blocks until a journal event or a watched PID exits, for the foreman to wait on when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.model:render: a writer; model:check is its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.morse:approve: writes a MORSE approval, and only that, when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.morse:predict: appends one MORSE path prediction for a diff to a journal outside the repository when run by hand; the review worker calls the same predict in process; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.mutate: construct mutate with its mutation-judged line written to the bus when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.owner:command: writes the patch and the command the window hands the owner for a card tree into ~/.construct/probes/owner-<card> when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.owner:say: writes one file of the owner's words and the time into ~/.construct-owner/answers when the owner runs it by hand, as construct say does from the package; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.release-notes:render: a writer; the release index tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.release:evidence: a read-only report on merged cards from the journal, not a verdict on a change
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.release:verify: a gate, deliberately outside: it inspects what was published, which does not exist when the harness runs
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.shard: appends the owner's shard line to the journal when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.task:close: appends a task's closing journal line when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.task:start: cuts a task's worktree from its card and writes its journal start line when run by hand; its own tests are its gate
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.test:watch: a local loop over the same tests
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.test:weights: rewrites the table CI balances its vitest shards by; it changes how the tests are split, not whether they pass
scriptsOutsideTheHarness.version-packages: the version step; the release index tests gate its output
